selection_rule.ordering: descending mean |SHAP| from the real-only grouped-CV model
selection_rule.note: Greedy: a candidate is added only if the resulting complete-case cohort still satisfies the row/paper floors, so a high-SHAP but sparsely reported descriptor is deliberately not forced in.

h2so4_M.categorical_treatment_reason: Only 4 discrete experimental settings occur (0.5/1/2/3 M); treating it as continuous would let the BN invent unobserved molarities.
h2so4_M.physical_meaning: Electrolyte proton activity; governs pseudocapacitive Ti-O redox and double-layer screening.

composition_family.physical_meaning: Pristine vs carbon / polymer / inorganic composite vs doped MXene.

scan_rate_mV_s.categorical_treatment_reason: A chosen instrument setting taking a handful of discrete values spanning 3 decades; discrete treatment avoids interpolating rates nobody measured.
scan_rate_mV_s.physical_meaning: CV sweep rate; controls the diffusion length probed and therefore rate-limited capacitance loss.

interlayer_A.physical_meaning: XRD (002) d-spacing: sets the ion-accessible gallery height; the central geometric descriptor for a PINN.
